other_conditions: Must have graduated or obtained an equivalent degree (including Alim or Shastri) after April 25 2018 from a government‑recognized or affiliated institution within Bihar
Graduate must be from general, technical, or professional courses
Applicant must have an account in any nationalized bank, recognized private bank or India Postal Payment Bank located in Bihar
If the name of the concerned college is not in the list, the applicant should contact the Registrar of their University to request its addition
benefits_summary: One-time financial incentive of ₹25,000 transferred directly to the beneficiary's bank account
